annotations.annotation_text: Introduction of the aggressive, bureaucratic twin in his full public persona, contrasting with the introverted Shem.

annotations.annotation_text: Shaun's literal and symbolic journey through the fluid female element (ALP), presenting himself as a messianic arrival.
sources: McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. http://fweet.org

annotations.annotation_text: The vessel of Shaun's arrival, evoking both a Guinness barrel and the infant Moses' basket, satirizing his claims to salvation.
sources: McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. http://fweet.org

annotations.annotation_text: Shaun's dogmatic and hypocritical address to the people, parodying rigid religious instruction and moralizing rhetoric.
sources: McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. http://fweet.org

annotations.annotation_text: Emphasizes Shaun's materialism and gluttony, physically contrasting with the starving artist archetype of his brother Shem.
sources: McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. http://fweet.org

annotations.annotation_text: Shaun's self-definition entirely in opposition to his brother, highlighting the adversarial duality at the core of the Wake's fraternal conflict.
sources: McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. http://fweet.org

annotations.annotation_text: The authoritative, Latinate tone Shaun adopts to assert dominance, mocking institutional church edicts and infallibility.
sources: McHugh, Roland. Annotations to Finnegans Wake. http://fweet.org
